notes.title: Major Update: Sonority 1.5 is here
notes.content:
[h1]Major improvements to Sonority![/h1]
Great news: Many improvements have found their way to Sonority!

Amongst them are such diverse elements as:

[list]
[*] an additional ultra-high-quality setting
[*] new tutorial-graphics and texts to facilitate the understanding of the gameplay-mechanics for novice users
[*] the gamepad-overlay auto-adjusts according to selected playmode and instrument
[*] lots of improvements to disk-size and general performance
[/list]
Have fun playing!

notes.title: Major Update: Full Steam Deck support
notes.content:
[h1]Sonority on Steam Deck![/h1]
Great news: Sonority is now fully compatible with the gamepad of the Steam Deck and all necessary adjustments for font readability and playability have been made. 
Additionally the size on disk has been greatly reduced.
Have fun playing!
